items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: he entered the hospital about six o'clock in the morning... we both walked in together... I gave him his supper... sneaking him a couple pieces of pie

ctx.x: Okay, well, Karen, if you just heard from Simon.

Alright. Well, he entered the hospital about six o'clock in the morning. I think it was Sunday morning, December 15th. And at that time we both walked in together. It was a very cold, windy, rainy day. Evening, night, all night it had rained. And he hadn't wanted to go to the hospital, but he was complaining of a sore throat. And his asthma attacks were coming on pretty rapidly during the night. So I thought it best if I just called the doctor at the time I was bringing him in. And his doctor had been out of…
